sources.title: Power BI reports for risks analysis and performance ranking
sources.scope: Official page actually fetched during the approved manufacturing research; receipt-based supplier performance and historical versus planned supply risk.
supported_claims: Supplier performance analysis distinguishes on-time, in-full, and on-time-in-full receipt measures.
Historical delivery performance and planned supply risk provide different evidence for supplier review.
sources.limitations: Supports the business concepts, not this implementation's exact cohort, reversal handling, denominator, provisional flags, rounding, thresholds, or priority policy. No D365 or Power BI metric equivalence or execution is claimed.

sources.title: Procurement and sourcing overview
sources.scope: Official page actually fetched during the approved manufacturing research; purchase confirmations, delivery schedules, arrival registration, and product receipts.
supported_claims: Purchase confirmation, dated split deliveries, arrival registration, and product receipt are distinct procurement concepts.
Supplier performance can be reviewed using purchase and delivery evidence.
sources.limitations: The scenario consumes only fictional exported posted-receipt records. It does not execute posting, inquiries, invoice matching, arrival registration, purchase amendments, or supplier communication. Logical tables in one JSON are not proof of physical multi-file native ingestion.

sources.title: Calculate requested ship dates for purchase orders
sources.scope: Official page actually fetched during the approved manufacturing research; requested/confirmed ship versus receipt dates and calendar/transport effects.
supported_claims: Requested and confirmed ship dates must be distinguished from requested and confirmed receipt dates.
Transport and calendars can affect ERP date calculation.
sources.limitations: All dates here are explicitly exported receipt dates or evidence-recording dates. All offsets use invented calendar-day rules; no shipping conversion, working-day calendar, transport engine, carrier ETA, or commitment verification is reproduced.
